name: Softcut Atelier
description: A scored confectionery slab: a bold condensed title, two square portraits in a stepped tray, and a broad reading panel with a coloured cut edge.

name: Marble Batch
description: An open, asymmetric page with a fine marbled side panel and a large serif title floating across the seam.

name: Copper Set
description: A thin foil frame around a tall portrait and a compressed heading; a tiny cocoa-coloured square seals the generous text panel.

name: Ribbon Knife
description: A long diagonal cutting line passes between two staggered photo tiles, with a small aligned title and a wide, quiet reading column.

name: Aftermelt
description: An indented literary page topped with oversized outline lettering, a block of member-colour bars and a small sugar-grain constellation.

name: Fudgephone
description: A flat-edged smartphone with a square camera aperture, contact portrait, incoming bubbles and a three-part navigation strip.

name: Setline
description: A compact candybar handset with a speaker grille, inset chat screen, broad clock bar and three chunky hardware keys.

name: Twin Temper
description: A book-fold phone: stacked contact windows occupy one screen, messages fill the second, and a narrow scored hinge connects them.

name: Sugarbyte
description: An upright keyboard phone with a small square portrait, a recessed conversation screen and a compact physical QWERTY deck.

name: Confection OS
description: A slim transparent-edge smartphone with an offset camera strip, a ticket-like contact header and sharply inset message bubbles.

name: Cubit
description: A tiny square reply with an extruded member-colour edge, a scored corner and a compact title.

name: Saltpin
description: A compact portrait-led note with a fine vertical rule and three small salt-crystal marks beside the title.

name: Niblet
description: A low, wide reply with a notched flavour tab, a condensed heading and a member-colour footing.

name: Two Cuts
sample: one for me, one for you
description: Two narrow square-edged portraits bracket a small shared title above a brief reply on an inset confectionery tray.

name: Crinkle
description: A miniature foil-inspired note with short crimped edges, a staggered signature and a little diagonal fold.
